# The Mathematical Model
This document provides a complex number based mathematical model.
## Sets and Parameters
### Sets

$$
\begin{aligned}
& N \text{ : buses} \\
& R \text{ : reference buses} \\
& E, E^R \text{ : branches, forward and reverse orientation} \\
& G, G_i \text{ : generators and generators at bus } i \\
& L, L_i \text{ : loads and loads at bus } i \\
& S, S_i \text{ : shunts and shunts at bus } i \\
\end{aligned}
$$

### Parameters

$$
\begin{aligned}
& S^{gl}_k, S^{gu}_k \quad \forall k \in G  \text{ : generator complex power bounds} \\
& c_{2k}, c_{1k}, c_{0k} \quad \forall k \in G \text{ : generator cost components} \\
& v^l_i, v^u_i \quad \forall i \in N \text{ : voltage bounds} \\
& S^d_k \quad \forall k \in L \text{ : load complex power consumption} \\
& Y^s_k \quad \forall k \in S \text{ : bus shunt admittance} \\
& Y_{ij}, Y^c_{ij}, Y^c_{ji} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch }\pi\text{-section parameters} \\
& T_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ :  branch complex transformation ratio} \\
& s^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch apparent power limit} \\
& i^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch current limit} \\
& \theta^{\Delta l}_{ij}, \theta^{\Delta u}_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch voltage angle difference bounds}
\end{aligned}
$$


## Mathmatical Model

A complete mathematical model is as follows,
### Variables
$$
\begin{aligned}
& S^g_k \quad \forall k\in G  \text{ : generator complex power dispatch} \\
& V_i \quad \forall i\in N  \text{ : bus complex voltage} \\
& S_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \text{ : branch complex power flow} \\
\\
\end{aligned}
$$

### Formulation
$$
\begin{aligned}
\text{minimize:} &  
\sum_{k \in G} c_{2k} (\Re(S^g_k))^2 + c_{1k}\Re(S^g_k) + c_{0k} \\

\text{subject to:} & \\
& \angle V_{r} = 0 \quad \forall r \in R \\
& S^{gl}_k \leq S^g_k \leq S^{gu}_k \quad \forall k \in G \\
& v^l_i \leq |V_i| \leq v^u_i \quad \forall i \in N \\
& \sum_{k \in G_i} S^g_k - \sum_{k \in L_i} S^d_k - \sum_{k \in S_i} (Y^s_k)^* |V_i|^2 = \sum_{(i,j)\in E_i \cup E_i^R} S_{ij} \quad \forall i\in N \\
& S_{ij} = (Y_{ij} + Y^c_{ij})^* \frac{|V_i|^2}{|T_{ij}|^2} - Y^*_{ij} \frac{V_i V^*_j}{T_{ij}} \quad \forall (i,j)\in E \\
& S_{ji} = (Y_{ij} + Y^c_{ji})^* |V_j|^2 - Y^*_{ij} \frac{V^*_i V_j}{T^*_{ij}} \quad \forall (i,j)\in E \\
& |S_{ij}| \leq s^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \\
& |S_{ij}| \leq |V_i| i^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \\
& \theta^{\Delta l}_{ij} \leq \angle (V_i V^*_j) \leq \theta^{\Delta u}_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E
\end{aligned}
$$

gen_buses = [int(bus_idx[int(gen_data[k, 0])]) for k in range(num_gens)]

# Parse branch data: [fbus, tbus, r, x, b, rateA, rateB, rateC, ratio, angle, status, ...]
branch_data = np.array(net['branch'])
num_branches = len(branch_data)

# Parse generator cost: [type, startup, shutdown, n, c(n), c(n-1), ..., c(0)]
gencost_data = np.array(net['gencost'])

print(f"Network: {num_buses} buses, {num_gens} generators, {num_branches} branches")

# Create optimization problem
opti = Opti()

# Decision variables: voltage magnitude and angle, generator real and reactive power
Vm = opti.variable(num_buses, 1)  # Voltage magnitude (pu)
Va = opti.variable(num_buses, 1)  # Voltage angle (radians)
Pg = opti.variable(num_gens, 1)   # Generator real power (pu)
Qg = opti.variable(num_gens, 1)   # Generator reactive power (pu)

# Objective: minimize generation cost
cost = 0
for k in range(num_gens):
    cost_row = gencost_data[k]
    if cost_row[0] == 2:  # Polynomial cost
        n = int(cost_row[3])
        coeffs = cost_row[4:4+n+1][::-1]  # Reverse to get highest power first
        Pg_k_MW = Pg[k] * baseMVA  # Convert to MW
        poly_cost = 0
        for i, c in enumerate(coeffs):
            poly_cost += c * Pg_k_MW**(n-i)
        cost += poly_cost

opti.minimize(cost)

# Voltage angle reference constraint (slack bus at bus 1, index 0)
slack_idx = 0
opti.subject_to(Va[slack_idx] == 0)

# Voltage bounds
for i in range(num_buses):
    Vmin = bus_data[i, 12]
    Vmax = bus_data[i, 11]
    opti.subject_to(Vm[i] >= Vmin)
    opti.subject_to(Vm[i] <= Vmax)

# Generator power bounds
for k in range(num_gens):
    Pmin = gen_data[k, 9] / baseMVA
    Pmax = gen_data[k, 8] / baseMVA
    Qmin = gen_data[k, 4] / baseMVA
    Qmax = gen_data[k, 3] / baseMVA
    
    opti.subject_to(Pg[k] >= Pmin)
    opti.subject_to(Pg[k] <= Pmax)
    opti.subject_to(Qg[k] >= Qmin)
    opti.subject_to(Qg[k] <= Qmax)

# Power balance constraints at each bus
# Using AC power flow equations: P_inj = sum(Vm[i]*Vm[j]*(Gij*cos(Va[i]-Va[j]) + Bij*sin(Va[i]-Va[j])))
for i in range(num_buses):
    # Sum of generation at bus i
    Pg_i = 0
    Qg_i = 0
    for k in range(num_gens):
        if gen_buses[k] == i:
            Pg_i += Pg[k]
            Qg_i += Qg[k]
    
    # Load and shunt at bus i (in per-unit)
    Pd = bus_data[i, 2] / baseMVA
    Qd = bus_data[i, 3] / baseMVA
    Gs = bus_data[i, 4] / baseMVA
    Bs = bus_data[i, 5] / baseMVA
    
    # Shunt admittance power consumption
    Psh = Gs * Vm[i]**2
    Qsh = -Bs * Vm[i]**2
    
    # Branch flows from/to bus i using pi-model
    P_inj = 0
    Q_inj = 0
    
    for j in range(num_branches):
        fbus_num = int(branch_data[j, 0])
        tbus_num = int(branch_data[j, 1])
        fbus = bus_idx[fbus_num]
        tbus = bus_idx[tbus_num]
        
        # Branch parameters (in per-unit)
        r = branch_data[j, 2]
        x = branch_data[j, 3]
        b = branch_data[j, 4]
        ratio = branch_data[j, 8]
        if ratio == 0:
            ratio = 1.0
        angle_shift = branch_data[j, 9] * np.pi / 180.0
        
        # Series admittance
        Z = r + 1j*x
        Y_series = 1.0 / Z
        G_series = real(Y_series)
        B_series = imag(Y_series)
        
        # Shunt susceptance (half on each end)
        B_shunt = b / 2.0
        
        if fbus == i:
            # Power flow from bus i to bus j
            # P_ij = (Vm[i]^2 * (G_series + B_shunt/ratio^2)) - Vm[i]*Vm[j]*(G_series*cos(dtheta) + B_series*sin(dtheta))
            # where dtheta = Va[i] - Va[j] - angle_shift
            dtheta = Va[i] - Va[j] - angle_shift
            P_ij = (Vm[i]**2 / ratio**2) * (G_series + B_shunt) - (Vm[i]*Vm[j]/ratio) * (G_series*cos(dtheta) + B_series*sin(dtheta))
            Q_ij = -(Vm[i]**2 / ratio**2) * (B_series + B_shunt) - (Vm[i]*Vm[j]/ratio) * (G_series*sin(dtheta) - B_series*cos(dtheta))
            P_inj += P_ij
            Q_inj += Q_ij
        
        if tbus == i:
            # Power flow from bus j to bus i
            dtheta = Va[j] - Va[i] + angle_shift
            P_ji = Vm[j]**2 * (G_series + B_shunt) - (Vm[i]*Vm[j]/ratio) * (G_series*cos(dtheta) + B_series*sin(dtheta))
            Q_ji = -Vm[j]**2 * (B_series + B_shunt) - (Vm[i]*Vm[j]/ratio) * (G_series*sin(dtheta) - B_series*cos(dtheta))
            P_inj += P_ji
            Q_inj += Q_ji
    
    # Power balance: Pg - Pd - Psh = P_inj
    opti.subject_to(Pg_i - Pd - Psh == P_inj)
    opti.subject_to(Qg_i - Qd - Qsh == Q_inj)

# Branch flow limits (apparent power)
for j in range(num_branches):
    fbus_num = int(branch_data[j, 0])
    tbus_num = int(branch_data[j, 1])
    fbus = bus_idx[fbus_num]
    tbus = bus_idx[tbus_num]
    rateA = branch_data[j, 5]
    
    # Branch parameters
    r = branch_data[j, 2]
    x = branch_data[j, 3]
    b = branch_data[j, 4]
    ratio = branch_data[j, 8]
    if ratio == 0:
        ratio = 1.0
    angle_shift = branch_data[j, 9] * np.pi / 180.0
    
    # Series admittance
    Z = r + 1j*x
    Y_series = 1.0 / Z
    G_series = real(Y_series)
    B_series = imag(Y_series)
    B_shunt = b / 2.0
    
    # Power flow from i to j
    dtheta = Va[fbus] - Va[tbus] - angle_shift
    P_ij = (Vm[fbus]**2 / ratio**2) * (G_series + B_shunt) - (Vm[fbus]*Vm[tbus]/ratio) * (G_series*cos(dtheta) + B_series*sin(dtheta))
    Q_ij = -(Vm[fbus]**2 / ratio**2) * (B_series + B_shunt) - (Vm[fbus]*Vm[tbus]/ratio) * (G_series*sin(dtheta) - B_series*cos(dtheta))
    S_ij = sqrt(P_ij**2 + Q_ij**2)
    
    if rateA > 0:
        opti.subject_to(S_ij <= rateA / baseMVA)

# Solver options
opts = {'ipopt': {'print_level': 5, 'max_iter': 2000, 'tol': 1e-6, 'acceptable_tol': 1e-4}}
opti.solver('ipopt', opts)

# Initial values
for i in range(num_buses):
    opti.set_initial(Vm[i], bus_data[i, 7])
    opti.set_initial(Va[i], bus_data[i, 8] * np.pi / 180.0)

for k in range(num_gens):
    opti.set_initial(Pg[k], gen_data[k, 1] / baseMVA)
    opti.set_initial(Qg[k], gen_data[k, 2] / baseMVA)

# Solve
try:
    sol = opti.solve()
    print("\nOptimization successful!")
    
    # Extract solution
    Vm_sol = sol.value(Vm).flatten()
    Va_sol = sol.value(Va).flatten()
    Pg_sol = sol.value(Pg).flatten()
    Qg_sol = sol.value(Qg).flatten()
    cost_sol = sol.value(cost)
    
    # Save solution to file for post-processing
    np.save('Vm_sol.npy', Vm_sol)
    np.save('Va_sol.npy', Va_sol)
    np.save('Pg_sol.npy', Pg_sol)
    np.save('Qg_sol.npy', Qg_sol)
    np.save('cost_sol.npy', np.array([cost_sol]))
    
    print(f"Total Cost: ${cost_sol:.2f}")
    print(f"Solution saved to .npy files")
    
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Optimization failed: {e}")

    traceback.print_exc()
    sys.exit(1)
